description: Source code defining a user-defined type (UDT) for matrices in Spark MLlib, enabling SQL interaction with Matrix objects, including serialization/deserialization and class definitions.

classes.name: MatrixUDT
classes.description: User-defined type for [[Matrix]] supporting SQL interaction, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Matrix object into an InternalRow for SQL storage.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an InternalRow into a Matrix object.

methods.name: userClass
methods.description: Returns the class of the Matrix type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on class name.

methods.name: asNullable
methods.description: Returns a nullable version of the MatrixUDT.
